prompt: Mini golf: get the ball into the hole before the windmill blocks it

intent.setting: A stylized outdoor mini-golf course featuring a prominent windmill obstacle and a central putting green.
intent.goal: Putt the ball into the hole before the rotating windmill blades block the path.
intent.fail: The windmill blade strikes the ball or blocks the hole in a way that makes scoring impossible or the timer expires.
intent.headline: Timing putt around moving windmill
